findings.title: Recheck the budget at the actual process-start boundary
findings.description: `_act` checks the budget before `_launch`, but `_launch` then mints the run ID and writes the journal entry before `launch` opens log files and calls `Popen` (`src/amoeba/runner/launch.py:212-214`). If that work takes the tick past its deadline—or a stop is requested meanwhile—the subprocess can still start after the budget refuses new calls. Recheck immediately before `Popen`, and handle a refusal after journaling so the unresolved entry is not later mistaken for a launch that occurred.

findings.title: Add a Runner load test
findings.description: The Runner starts detached `sq` processes and invokes `cf` subprocesses, but its added tests exercise fakes, end-to-end scenarios, and crash recovery—not load under a realistic Runner configuration. The testing rules require a CI-gated load test for environment-layer, network, or concurrency paths, with latency, throughput, or resource bounds. Add a Runner load test in `tests/load/` that exercises those bounds.
